Roles and dashboard access. Decide who can do what, and what each person sees.
Open Settings, and choose Roles and permissions. The permission matrix shows what each system role can do, from Company Admin to Employee.
Permissions are checked by the server on every request. Data is also limited by scope. Managers see their reporting line, and team leads see their teams.
Under Members, find a person, and choose their role from the list. Role changes take effect immediately.
The menu at the end of each row can reset two step verification, or sign the person out everywhere.
Next, open Dashboard access. Choose a person on the left. You can filter by role.
Turn sections on or off, for example Screenshots, Reports or Live view. Then click Save changes.
Hiding a section only hides it for that person. It never changes their role, their permissions, or what the system records.
The change applies on their next sign in, or refresh.
